versions.changelog:
Initial release of Alibaba Cloud OSS Transfer Acceleration Diagnosis skill.

- Detects when OSS transfer acceleration is not taking effect due to endpoint misuse or feature disabled.
- Differentiates between OSS Data Accelerator (same-region, hot data) and Transfer Acceleration (cross/cross-border).
- Attribits slowness and fees for cross-border OSS access; answers typical user questions on slowness, endpoint, or charges.
- Enforces strict read-only behavior—never enables, disables, or mutates OSS configurations.
- Only reads outputs from included scripts; avoids direct or ad-hoc OSS API/SKD/ossutil calls.
- Provides diagnostics solely based on verified data from control-plane queries and official documentation, with guided degradation if queries fail.
